rows.text: Infomerics upgrades bank-facility ratings to IVR BBB+/Stable (long-term) and IVR A2 (short-term), on a reduced Rs 115 cr facility (from Rs 120.80 cr).

board approves **Rs 12 crore** of capex for modernising its sleeper and infrastructure sites (incl. machinery procurement), alongside a 40-acre Bikaner land purchase for its M.S. Pipe project and Rs 2.61 crore of staff housing.
